vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via the `zipObjectDeep` function, which may allow an attacker to modify the prototype of `Object`, causing the addition or modification of an existing property that will exist on all objects.

## References
- https://github.com/lodash/lodash/issues/4874

vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via the `setKey()` function.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Authentication
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Improper Authentication. In versions `<=8.5.1`, the library can be misconfigured to accept tokens signed with an insecure algorithm, allowing signature verification to be bypassed.

vulnerabilities.title: Cross-site Request Forgery
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
Affected versions of this package leak the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie value to third-party hosts, allowing an attacker to view that token.

vulnerabilities.title: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
vulnerabilities.description:
## Overview
Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to signature verification bypass when parsing certain malformed RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures.
